cost_basis: 2024-01-15 tariff schedules and 2024 Q1 Suezmax TCE; vessel 1,000,000 bbl cargo, $82.8M hull, $45,800/day; nothing here is fitted to the transit counts
retired_targets_note: The former block (calibration_loss 0.3404, -30.89% vs -29.46% Suez transits, share error 0.0145) described a cost basis that divided per-transit dollars by the observed all-tanker cargo, 347,000 bbl at Suez, while the toll was converted on 1,000,000. Those figures cannot be reproduced from the observed series on a consistent basis and are retired. The share is reported as a sensitivity: the model has no stickiness term, so its substitution response is an upper bound on rerouting.
